mci.title: CI failures
mci.lede: Watched branches that went red, one row per error.
mci.logNote: From the job's log, with secrets removed.
mci.noSample: No log excerpt was kept for this failure.
mci.runsCount: {n, plural, one {# failing run} other {# failing runs}}
mci.foreignPr: This failure is on someone else's pull request (#{n}): agnts only comments there.
mci.fixConfirm: agnts opens a ticket to fix this failure. You review the fix before anything is pushed.
mci.mutedDone: Muted: agnts leaves this failure alone until you unmute it.
mci.ciFixes: {n, plural, one {CI sent the pull request back once} other {CI sent the pull request back # times}}
